steps_covered.source_support_verification: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_THIS_ROUND -- a separate real step (comqutor_alpha.source_provenance); finding a claim in alpha_matches.json only proves a model output existed, never that it has verified source support.

scoring_WITH_STALE_OUTCOME_CODE_as_origi.note: confusion_matrix rows are the human label, columns are the system's outcome (an Alpha ID for MATCHED, or the literal outcome_code for NONE/CALL_FAILED/PARSE_FAILED/UNAVAILABLE/ABSTAINED_AMBIGUOUS/SKIPPED_BUDGET_STOP) -- failures and abstentions are never dropped from this matrix or from scored_sample_count. Items where the reviewer explicitly answered UNABLE_TO_JUDGE are counted in unable_to_judge_count and total_judged_count but excluded from scored_sample_count/accuracy/precision/recall/confusion_matrix -- never coerced into a right-or-wrong comparison.
